sources.name: Ember monthly electricity data (global)
sources.use: Monthly hydro generation by country: the label for the tier-1 shortfall forecasts and backtests.

sources.name: Ember yearly electricity data (global)
sources.use: Hydro share and TWh by country: selects the 48 hydro-dependent countries (hydro >= 30% and >= 1 TWh).

sources.name: Ember China provincial monthly generation
sources.use: Sichuan province monthly hydro generation, treated as its own grid (CHN-SC).

sources.name: GRACE/GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage (GFZ GravIS Level-3 TWS grid, RL06)
sources.provider: NASA/DLR/GFZ (GRACE, GRACE-FO); gridded by GFZ GravIS
sources.coverage: 2002-04..2026-08, monthly (with the 2017-2018 gap between GRACE and GRACE-FO)
sources.use: Water stored in each hydropower basin: drying trends since 2002 and a predictor for the shortfall models.

sources.name: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 based meteorology and soil wetness)
sources.coverage: monthly 1981..; daily to about 3 days ago
sources.license: Free and open (NASA Earth science data policy; cite NASA POWER)
sources.use: Basin precipitation, root-zone and surface soil wetness and temperature (stand-ins for GPM and SMAP) for trends, ENSO fingerprints and model features.

sources.name: G-REALM global reservoir and lake levels (satellite radar altimetry)
sources.provider: NASA GSFC / USDA FAS (TOPEX/Poseidon, Jason-1/2/3, Sentinel-6)
sources.license: Free and open (NASA/USDA public data; cite G-REALM)
sources.use: Lake Kariba water level from space, converted to % usable storage: the reservoir forecast target.

sources.name: Oceanic Nino Index (ONI)
sources.use: El Nino / La Nina phase for the ENSO fingerprints and the ENSO-only baseline.

sources.name: GPCP v2.3 monthly precipitation (satellite + gauge)
sources.provider: NASA GSFC / GEWEX; distributed by NOAA PSL
sources.use: Main rainfall record for the ENSO fingerprints and basin rainfall trends. It drifts dry after 2019 in many regions, so rain trends use 2002-2019 and the ENSO result is checked on 1981-2019.

sources.name: CPC ENSO diagnostic discussion (official ENSO outlook)
sources.use: The official ENSO forecast that the 6-18 month horizon consumes (Patronus does not forecast ENSO itself).

sources.name: NASA GEOS-S2S-3 subseasonal-to-seasonal forecasts (near real time)
sources.license: Free and open (NASA Earth science data policy)
sources.use: Seasonal outlook for the coming months over the basins, shown alongside the forecast (not backtested).

sources.name: Global Power Plant Database v1.3
sources.use: Locations and capacities of hydro plants, used to pick basins and capacity-weight them per country. Newer plants (e.g. Coca Codo Sinclair) may be missing.

sources.name: HydroBASINS (HydroSHEDS) level-4 basins
sources.use: River basin polygons that hold the hydro plants; the unit for trends and features.

sources.name: NASA Black Marble night lights (VNP46A2, Suomi NPP VIIRS) via NASA GIBS
sources.license: Free and open (NASA Earth science data policy)
sources.use: Night-lights replay of Zambia 2024 and Ecuador 2024; approximate brightness change from display imagery.

sources.name: ONS open data: daily stored energy (EAR) and natural inflow energy (ENA) by subsystem
sources.license: CC BY (Creative Commons Atribuicao, as listed on the portal)
sources.use: Brazil reservoir storage and inflows, as a ground-truth check on the Brazil forecast.

sources.name: Zambezi River Authority: Kariba lake levels, allocations and press statements
sources.license: Public web pages, copyright ZRA (cited, not redistributed)
sources.use: Kariba operating range (475.50-488.50 m), usable storage, the 2027 allocation cut and ZRA's own projection.

sources.name: World Bank, Vietnam Macro Monitoring / Taking Stock, August 2023
sources.use: Preliminary cost of Vietnam's 2023 power shortage (about $1.4B, roughly 0.3% of GDP).

sources.name: IMF press release 24/413: Zambia, staff-level agreement on the 4th ECF review (11 Nov 2024)
sources.use: Macroeconomic impact of Zambia's 2024 drought and power crisis.

sources.name: ZESCO tariff application to the Energy Regulation Board (July 2024)
sources.provider: ZESCO / Energy Regulation Board of Zambia
sources.use: Replacement power costs for Zambia (Eskom 17c, Mozambique/Karpowership 22c, diesel 26c, blended 23.2c per kWh) in the cost model.

sources.name: News reports and official statements (crisis timelines)
sources.use: Dates of warnings, cuts and recoveries for the crisis timelines and night-lights captions; each item carries its own link.

nasa_data_summary.mission: Suomi NPP VIIRS Black Marble (via NASA GIBS)

ai_disclosure: AI tools (Claude) were used for research, critique, coding, and drafting the written briefs. The project concept came from the team. All numbers come from the data pipeline and cited sources.
notes: Licences are as stated by each provider at the time of download; check the provider page before reuse.
The IMF site returns HTTP 403 to automated requests, so its URL could not be re-checked by the pipeline.
